thesis: AMPH is in a confirmed uptrend (close 29.38 above SMA20 26.68, SMA50 25.50, SMA200 22.30; relative strength +0.49) after a Q3 print with revenue +8.2% YoY and net income +118% YoY, at low multiples (forward P/E 8.835, EV/EBITDA 8.643). The health care-led rotation (XLV 21-day +10.26%) is a tailwind despite the risk-off NASDAQ tape. The edge is modest: a limit entry in the 27.90-28.50 pullback zone gives reward/risk of about 1.75 to the 31.0 high, and chasing 29.38 is not justified.
invalidation: A daily close below 26.60, or a close back below the 11-06 low of 27.80 that fails to recover, undoes the post-earnings breakout.
